brief.goal: 实现乾坤技术侧只读 reconcile：读取本地 token 脱敏状态，查询账户身份和已有监测序号，唯一命中时写入 v2 Postgres；本任务不创建监测序号。
brief.document_instruction_boundary: Requirements documents are inputs only; API behavior and v2 Postgres remain the execution truth.

credential_input.owner_key_source: Qiankun API token owner / SSO user id; must match /tf/account_info/accountIndex list[].sso_owner for advertiser 1871922346964041.
credential_input.owner_key_blank_bootstrap_policy: Allowed only during task 2 execution when there is exactly one pending local credential. Task 2 may use that single token for readonly /tf/account_info/accountIndex and /tf/ad/index after account identity resolves, but must not backfill the local owner_key until the user explicitly confirms it.
credential_input.sensitive_storage_policy: Local .local JSON only. Do not commit, print, log, store in Postgres, or include in task files.

local_credential_status.note: Token value is intentionally not stored in this manifest. The pending owner_key must be confirmed from Qiankun account identity before reconcile can use the credential.

bootstrap_probe_evidence.source_doc: docs/.参考文档/投放序列号/api-docs-20260825.md section 8 获取投放监测序号列表
bootstrap_probe_evidence.owner_key_inference: Ignored for task 2 execution per user instruction. Do not backfill owner_key from this monitor-list result. In section 8, list[].sso_owner is documented as 数据归属人姓名 and returned 冯美钰; task 2 uses a fresh /tf/account_info/accountIndex identity probe.
bootstrap_probe_evidence.sensitive_storage: No token, request header, raw request, raw response, or complete touchpoint URL is stored here.

allowed_external_calls.purpose: Resolve advertiser account identity, sso_owner, owner_name, technical account record id, media_account_id, and agent_id.
Query existing monitor serial numbers by target account and monitor_provision fixed parameters.

forbidden_actions: trying another credential when owner_key mismatches account sso_owner
guessing monitor_id when /tf/ad/index returns multiple candidates or no candidate
fabricating touchpoint_url when monitor list does not return a complete URL
writing token/secret/auth_code/Cookie/request header/raw request/raw response/complete touchpoint URL to task files, normal logs, API, frontend, or ordinary Postgres fields
allowed_writes: mwb.game_route_defaults.raw_defaults.monitor_provision only after readonly verification or explicit local configuration decision
readonly_reconcile_flow: Read .local/qiankun-monitor.env and .local/qiankun-passport-credentials.json; output only redacted status.
If owner_key is blank, allow only a single pending-credential bootstrap probe when exactly one token is saved locally; do not try multiple credentials.
Use the account row sso_owner as a candidate owner_key, then require human confirmation before writing it back to the local credential store.
Require exactly one account row for advertiser 1871922346964041.
Require selected credential owner_key to match account row sso_owner; mismatch blocks immediately.
Resolve technical_account_record_id, media_account_id, agent_id, owner_key, and owner_name as strings.
Call /tf/ad/index using target account plus monitor_provision parameters.
If one exact existing monitor candidate is found, upsert redacted run, advertiser account, touchpoint status, and evidence.
If zero or multiple candidates are found, do not create and do not guess; record a blocker for task 3 or manual decision.
If the monitor list includes a complete https touchpoint URL, store it only in controlled account_touchpoints.touchpoint_url and store hash/ref in summaries.
If no complete URL is present, mark touchpoint_url_unresolved_after_monitor_list and keep Workflow node 2 blocked.
